content: Didanosine, marketed under the brand name VIDEX®, is a synthetic purine nucleoside analogue with antiviral activity specifically targeting HIV-1. It is available in two formulations: VIDEX Pediatric Powder for Oral Solution and VIDEX® EC Delayed-Release Capsules, which contain enteric-coated beadlets. The chemical name of didanosine is 2′,3′-dideoxyinosine. It is important to note that didanosine is chemically unstable in acidic environments. For instance, at a pH level below 3 and a temperature of 37°C, approximately 10% of didanosine degrades into hypoxanthine within less than 2 minutes.
